content: Dawitenne Bersaabeho

Kawoti olas keziza ofinththa aginatan Dawiti Iyo7aabe kawo shuumetaranne kumeththa olanchchatara gaththi olas yeddides; isttika Amoone dere asaa dhayssida; Eraaba katamayo giddoththida; gido attiin he wode Dawiti Yerusalaamen attides.
Issi gallas bilahe wode Dawiti dhiskofe beeggidi kawo keeththa pooqe bolla kezidi simerettishe issi maccassaya ba bolla meecettishin be7ides; maccassaya keeha mala lo7o.
Dawiti as kiittidi maccassay gishshas oyshechchides; addezikka, «Hanna Hiite dere as Ooriyo machcho El7aame biyo Bersaabeho gidekkee?» gides.
Hessafe guye Dawiti as yeddidi izo baakko ehisiin izi dizaso geladus; histtiin izira zin7ides; he wode iza macca naas yiza agina wogappe geeya uttadus.
Maccassaya qanththatada Dawites, «Ta nees shaaradis» gashe kiita yeddadus.
Hessafe guye Dawiti Iyo7aabes, «Hiite dere as Ooriyo haa taakko yedda» gi kiittides; Iyo7aabeykka Ooriyo Dawitekko yeddides.
Ooriyoy Dawitekko yiin Dawiti Iyo7aabenne olanchchata saroteth oychchides; hessaththoka olazi waani olettizaakko iza oychchides.
Hessafe guye Dawiti Ooriyo, «Ane neni neso baada toho meecetta» gides; Ooriyoy kawo keeththafe moyzetti bides; kawozi mogota kath geedora izas yeddides.
Gido attiin Ooriyoy ba godaa oosanchchata ubbaara kawo keeththa gibbe penge bolla ichchides attiin baso bibeenna.
Dawiti, «Ooriyoy baso bibeenna» gizayssa siyida mala Ooriyo, «Ne buro ogeppe gelo bolla daasa diikkii? Neso ays babeekkii?» gi oychchides.

Ooriyoykka Dawites, «Taabotay, Isra7eele asaynne Yuhuda asay dunkaanen dishin, ta godaa Iyo7aabeynne ta godaa asay coo demba bolla dishin tani maanaassinne uyanaas qasseka ta machcheyra aqanaas waana taso boo? Intte asho! Ta hayssa mala ooththike» gides.
Dawitikka izas, «Ero, ne hach hayssan aqikko wonto ta nena moyzana» gides. Hessa gishshas Ooriyoy he gallassinne wonteththa gallas Yerusalaamen takkides.

Wonteththa gallas Dawiti ba dizason izas gibira giigsidi mizi, ushshi kalssidi iza maththosides; gadey qammishin Ooriyoy gaden ongetti diza hiixan ichchanaas iza godaa aylleti dizaso bides attiin baso bibeenna.
Gadey wontishin Dawiti Iyo7aabes dabdaabbe xaafidi Ooriyo bolla yeddides.
Dabdaabezan, «Ooriyo olay minnizason essa; heen izi cadetti hayqqana mala aggaagidi baqatite» gi xaafides.
Hessa gishshas Iyo7aabey katamayo giddoththida wode keehi eqettiza olanchchati diza miixan Ooriyo essides.
Katamayin diza asay kezidi Iyo7aabera ola danxxides; Dawite olanchchatappe guuththati kundida; hessaththoka Hiite dere as Ooriyoy hayqqides.
Iyo7aabey olason hanida ubbaa Dawites kiitti yeddides.
Kiitetti bizayssas, «Hayssa olaa hanotaa ne kawozas yootidaappe guye,
Kawozi ne bolla hanqettidi, ‹Intte olettanaas ays hessa mala katamaykko keehi shiiqidetii? Gimbeza kaarara intte bolla wondafe dukkanayssa erekketii?
Yerubesheete

naa Abimelekke issi maccassaya Teebeesen gimbeza kaarara woxa mayde yeddada wodhabeekkee? Histtiin intte ays hessa keena gede gimbezaakko shiiqidetii?› gi oychchiko nenikka izas zaarada, ‹Hiite dere as ne oosanchcha Ooriyoy hayqqides› gaada yoota» gides.
Hessa gishshas kiitettida addezi dendi bides; hee bi gakkida mala Iyo7aabey yeddida kiita ubbaa Dawites yeddides.
Kiitetti bidayssi Dawites, «Asati nu bolla wolqqamidi nuna olanaas demba gakkanaas yida; gido attiin nuni istta katamay penge gakkanaas gooddidos.
Hessafe guye wondafe dukkiza asati gimbeza bolla uttidi ne aylleta gidida nu bolla wondafe dukkida; kawoza oosanchchatappe guuththata wodhida; ne oosanchcha Hiite dere as Ooriyoykka hayqqides» gides.

Dawiti kiitetti yidayssas, «Neni Iyo7aabes, ‹Ay wode gidiinkka mashshay issito hessafe woykko hayssafe mees; hessa gishshas hayssa ha hanozan kayottofa; katamayo ola oykkanaassinne dhayssanaas minna› gaada minththeththa» gides.
Ooriyo machcheya izi azinay hayqqidayssa siyada keeha mishettada izas yeekkadus.
Kayoteththa wodey aadhdhidaappe guye Dawiti kiitti ehisidi izo baas machcho ekkides; iza Dawites attuma naa yeladus; gido attiin Dawiti ooththida oosoy GODAA ufayssibeenna.
